meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 把 Emacs 接成 NanoClaw 的一个频道:安装并在 Emacs 里配置好后,可以在聊天缓冲区里问答,或把 org 选区、子树发给助手,回复以子标题形式落在原文件里。
howto.when: 在 .env 里设 EMACS_ENABLED=true 并在 Emacs 配置里绑定按键后,按 C-c n c 打开聊天缓冲区,或按 C-c n o 发送 org 内容时接管。

howto.what_en: Adds Emacs as a NanoClaw channel: after install and Emacs config, you can chat in a buffer, or send an org region or subtree and get the reply as a child heading in place.
howto.when_en: After EMACS_ENABLED=true is set in .env and keys are bound in Emacs, it takes over when you open the chat buffer (C-c n c) or send org content (C-c n o).

say_en.text: I use Doom Emacs — write the config.el keybindings
say_en.note: Matches the Doom load and map! snippet

say_en.text: Generate an EMACS_AUTH_TOKEN and put it in .env
say_en.note: Locks the local HTTP endpoint with a bearer token
